svg.title: Payslips an employee can read — SoftTrack web design mockup (#298)
svg.desc: Compensation and payroll runs are readable by finance admins and nobody else, which leaves nothing for one’s own. For each paid run a person gets a payslip read from the run’s frozen lines, under My pay beside their expenses, with a line saying that tax and statutory deductions are not computed here.
svg.text: · one’s own pay, where one can see it
What was I paid in August

g.text: Settings → My pay, signed in as Daniel
What SoftTrack says you were paid. Read by you and by finance admins, and nobody else.
Gross agreed pay and adjustments as recorded in SoftTrack. Tax and statutory

svg.text: An instance can turn it off

g.text: Off for an organisation whose payslips come from its
payroll provider. My pay leaves the settings.

svg.text: Routes under the person’s own path, like their expenses, with their
own schemas, listed by name in the finance sweep’s allowlist.
Done when each person has a payslip per paid run with the period, compensation, each pay item, reimbursements carried and the total, read from the frozen lines; My pay shows
current compensation and the payslips; only the person and finance admins read them; a payslip downloads as PDF and says what it is; the person is notified when the run is paid;
and an instance setting turns the page off.

g.text: Read from the run’s frozen lines
so it cannot differ from what was
It says what it is. A payslip that
looked official and was not would
A person could not see what SoftTrack says
they were paid. Finance answered by hand.
The whole page goes, for whoever pays through a provider.
